prompt:
Design a desktop web-app screenshot for the Portuguese "Dashboard Geral" operations dashboard at 1600x1000 landscape. Direction: a contemporary teletext/index system translated into a usable digital control panel, flat near-black charcoal background with crisp warm-white type, electric cyan separators/active selection, yellow highlights, small monospace index numbers used sparingly. Strong grid, high contrast and clear reading, no retro TV frame, scanlines, screen effects or browser chrome. The content must look like a practical dashboard, not a poster.

At the very top, show a real app header. Breadcrumb on left "Principal › Visão Geral". In the center, a scrolling ticker within a clipped horizontal viewport: a small green refresh glyph, label "Sincronizado", city/date sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", fade masks and small directional chevrons so it clearly reads as horizontally scrollable. Theme and profile at far right. Keep header ticker separate from filters. The city/date sequence is illustrative placeholder content only.

Under the header show the entire full-width real filter area, clearly divided into two rows with individual field labels and select boxes. Row one: "Período", segmented mode "Ano/Semana" selected / "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07". Row two: "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", button "Limpar". All labels and values must stay legible and unshortened. Do not substitute compact chips or a single summary field. Use cyan only for the selected Ano/Semana mode and small active borders; visually maintain usable contrast.

Under filter, include a left navigation rail using the existing labels exactly: group Principal — Visão Geral selected, Análise, UTR, Comparação. Group Operacional — Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado. Group Marketing — Operacional Marketing, Marketing. Main workspace title "Resumo Operacional" and caption "Ano 2026 · Semanas 05, 06, 07". Three stats: "Corridas ofertadas" 18.450, "Aderência" 74,8%, "Praças" 2. Then lower panels: line chart "Evolução diária" with two series "Ofertadas" and "Aceitas"; compact table "Por praça" columns Praça / Corridas / Aderência and rows Guarulhos / 11.230 / 76,1%; Centro / 7.220 / 72,8%; Total / 18.450 / 74,8%. Use a distinctly dark theme with restrained cyan and yellow but prioritize legibility. All data are illustrative mock values. No fabricated statuses, alerts, taglines or controls.
demoData: Métricas e pares cidade/data são demonstrativos, não dados do Supabase.
